summary: Can-Fite BioPharma Ltd. furnished a Form 6-K attaching a press release announcing a peer-reviewed publication on Piclidenoson for canine osteoarthritis. No transaction, investment, or special-situation event is described. The filing is a routine disclosure of scientific progress under a licensing deal with Vetbiolix. No financial terms, board actions, or structural changes are reported. This is an ordinary current report, not a special situation.
